messages:
From: Elena Ramos <elena@techforum.org>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Micro-summit — attendee access stipend request

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the quick call today. Our Micro-Summit (May 18) is aimed at early-stage product teams — roughly 120–160 registered attendees expected. A lot of folks want to try Redwood in-session. Can Redwood provide short-lived promo credits or a trial extension that we can hand out to attendees (no more than 1 per person)? Ideally: one-click redeemable promo codes that grant a 14-day trial with a token allowance (we were thinking ~2,000 tokens) and a lightweight landing doc.

We have a small sponsor budget but would prefer to keep this as a co-promotional trial rather than a paid sponsorship. If there are limits on SKU or per-account caps, please flag them.

Attaching a one-pager with the event program. Happy to share sample messaging for the redeem flow.

Best,
Elena Ramos
Events Director — TechForum Collective
Attachment: MicroSummit_Proposal_v3.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Micro-summit — attendee access stipend request

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding an ask from TechForum. They want ~150 one-off promo codes (14-day trial, ~2k tokens). Their audience is mostly startups and product teams in NA.

Quick questions:
- Is 2k tokens a typical amount per attendee for a demo-friendly session?
- Do we have an existing promo SKU for 14-day trials that we can issue in bulk?
- Any compliance/accounting flags if we issue these as marketing credits (rather than free trials attached to an account)?

Goal: turn-around and proposal back to Elena by Monday morning.

Thanks — Connor
Head of Field Eng
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 18:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Micro-summit — attendee access stipend request

Connor / Marcus — quick take: 2k tokens should be fine for a 14-day window for demo/training usage (roughly equivalent to a few hundred short completions + some generation). We do have a promo SKU (MARKETING-14D) that Marketing and Sales can request for events; it creates single-use redeem codes and tracks redemptions.

Operational notes:
- We cap per-account redemptions to one code on marketing SKUs; works for their ask.
- Need legal sign-off if we provide >10k total token value for non-contracted organizations (expense > $X requires approval). Assuming 150 * 2k = 300k tokens — flagging for finance.
- I can seed a sheet with codes but would prefer to route through Partner Ops for bulk issuance.

Suggest the reply: offer 150 single-use MARKETING-14D codes (14 days / 2k tokens) plus a co-branded landing doc. Ask if they need codes pre-assigned to emails or just a bulk code pack to hand out. I can draft language for the landing page.

—Marissa
Head of Growth Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Promo_Allocation_2027Q2.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 24 Apr 2027 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Micro-summit — attendee access stipend request

Thanks team — finance/partnerships here. A couple of checklist items before we sign off:
1) Budget: 150 * 2k tokens = 300k tokens. For Q2 promo reserves that is within the event pool but we need to mark as "co-marketing credit" and book against DF-2027-0425-REDWOOD-01.
2) Redemption model: single-use codes are preferred. If they want email-locked codes we need a csv with emails 48h before event.
3) Measurement: require a short UTM param and an internal HubSpot custom property to capture source=techforum_micro_summit.

If Marissa can generate the codes and drop them in Partner Ops, we can approve today and I will file the accounting entry.

Marcus
VP, Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <elena@techforum.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Micro-summit — attendee access stipend request

Elena — happy to confirm. We can provide: 
- 150 single-use MARKETING-14D promo codes (14 days, 2,000 tokens each)
- Co-branded landing page + short redeem copy (we'll share within 24 hours)
- Measurement: add source=techforum_micro_summit UTM and HubSpot deal DF-2027-0425-REDWOOD-01

Options for delivery:
A) Bulk code pack (single csv) that you distribute at the event (no email-locking) — simplest.
B) Email-locked codes (we generate per-email csv) — we'll need the attendee email list 48h before the event.

We will route issuance through Partner Ops. For accounting we will book as co-marketing credit under the deal referenced above. Mime attachments: Promo_Allocation_2027Q2.xlsx (breakdown) and MicroSummit_Proposal_v3.pdf (your program).

Please confirm which delivery option you prefer and whether you want our team to host the landing page or embed the copy in your site. Once you confirm, Marissa will generate the codes and Marcus will book the credit.

Best,
Connor
Head of Field Eng — Redwood Inference
